judgments.reason: The span 'an enhanced left-adrenal heterogeneous mass measuring 4.1 × 3.4 cm' appears literally in the vignette and clinically supports pheochromocytoma as a component of the composite diagnosis, since an enhancing adrenal mass is a hallmark imaging finding for pheochromocytoma.

The span 'systolic apical ballooning' appears literally in the vignette (left ventriculography confirmed systolic apical ballooning) and is the defining feature of Takotsubo cardiomyopathy, clinically supporting that component of the composite diagnosis.
